title: Causal Decomposition of the AIxCC Security Gap: Human vs. AI Bottleneck in Finding the Hardest Bugs

original_idea.body:
# Causal Decomposition of the AIxCC Security Gap: Human vs. AI Bottleneck in Finding the Hardest Bugs

**Problem:** AIxCC reached 77% detection. The 23% gap could be caused by: (a) insufficient formal specification of the target behavior, (b) lack of deep domain knowledge (protocol-specific logic), (c) structural limitations of current LLM reasoning. These causes require different interventions.

**Direction:** Select 10 AIxCC undetected vulnerabilities from the SoK paper. For each, attempt to detect it using: (a) enhanced formal specification, (b) domain expert hint injection, (c) an LLM with extended context (full codebase). Measure which intervention closes more of the gap.

**Why it matters:** Knowing the causal structure of the 23% gap directs research toward the right intervention. If formal spec is the bottleneck, invest in better spec tools. If domain knowledge is the bottleneck, invest in specialized models.

**Relevant context:** AIxCC SoK paper (arXiv 2602.07666) analyzes undetected vulnerabilities at a structural level but does not test targeted interventions. Open-source finalist systems are being released, enabling experimentation.
